import chess

# Note: castling rights unknown; assume KQ for white. Also try without.
for f in [fen, "r1bq1r2/1p3pp1/p1n1p3/3nPkbP/8/P1N5/1P2QPP1/R1B1K2R w - - 0 1"]:
    board = chess.Board(f)
    print("FEN:", f)
    print("legal moves:", len(list(board.legal_moves)))
    mates = []
    for m in board.legal_moves:
        board.push(m)
        if board.is_checkmate():
            mates.append(m.uci())
        board.pop()
    print("mate in 1:", mates)
    # Also checks
    checks = []
    for m in board.legal_moves:
        board.push(m)
        if board.is_check():
            checks.append(m.uci())
        board.pop()
    print("checks:", checks)
